competitors.name: ALDI
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported ALDI temporarily cut prices nationwide on fresh foods and other selected items through at least Nov. 3, estimating $86 million in additional shopper savings. The grocer said nearly one-third of its everyday in-store assortment is now priced below 2025 levels.

competitors.name: Target
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Target has 50% more newness in food and beverage this year than last year and wants to become a leading launch destination for founder-led brands. The retailer is curating owned, national and emerging brands around trend relevance, differentiation and quality for the price.

competitors.name: Fresh Thyme Market
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Fresh Thyme Market and SPINS named 'Frozen Passport' among the grocer's top trends for 2027, forecasting the freezer aisle as a destination for authentic, restaurant-quality global cuisine at a fraction of dine-out prices. The forecast also highlights nutrient density in smaller portions and elevated meal shortcuts.

trends.magnitude: ALDI estimates $86 million in additional savings through at least Nov. 3 and says nearly one-third of its everyday assortment is below 2025 prices.
trends.context: The cuts center on fresh items rather than frozen pizza, but they lower shoppers' reference prices across the basket. Premium frozen brands need a clear value story as discounters intensify affordability messaging.

trends.topic: Large retailers accelerating emerging-brand product discovery
trends.magnitude: Target says food-and-beverage newness is 50% higher this year than last year, while product-development timelines are compressing from two or three years to six to nine months.
trends.context: Target is explicitly seeking differentiated founder-led brands but expects products to be on-trend, affordable, approachable and fast to market. That creates an opening for Real Dough only if its differentiation and readiness are immediately legible.

trends.topic: Global restaurant flavors moving deeper into frozen
trends.magnitude: Fresh Thyme and SPINS elevated 'Frozen Passport' to one of 10 forecast grocery trends for 2027.
trends.context: The forecast positions frozen as a low-effort, lower-cost route to restaurant-quality global cuisine. Real Dough can use this as retailer-facing support for premium frozen meals built around distinctive flavor and convenience rather than competing only on price.
